recent_posts.title: Expose Your Composable Storefront in Page Designer Without ISML
recent_posts.summary: PWA Kit v3.17 introduces a headless Page Designer architecture for Salesforce B2C Commerce composable storefronts, eliminating the need to maintain duplicate ISML and React implementations. Developers can now build Page Designer components once in React, using two new metadata attributes: `arch_type: "headless"` and `route`. The new approach also introduces dynamic component loading (lazy loading/code splitting), loading only components in use. A migration checklist covers steps from installing the new `@salesforce/storefront-next-runtime` package to deploying and testing the updated storefront.

recent_posts.title: The Salesforce Developer’s Guide to TDX 2026
recent_posts.summary: A guide for Salesforce developers attending TDX 2026 (April 15-16, San Francisco or virtual via Salesforce+). Highlights include the main keynote on building the Agentic Enterprise, the True to the Core roadmap session with Parker Harris, and a Hackathon Showdown with a $50,000 prize. The guide covers hands-on areas like Agentforce Vibes, Platform Park demos, Camp Mini Hack challenges, and Agentforce consultations. Recommended developer sessions span Agentforce/AI integration, Apex best practices, API security, LWC roadmap, Data 360, and Zero Trust with MCP. Also includes tips for virtual attendees on Salesforce+.

recent_posts.title: Build Custom Property Editors and Types for Experience Builder
recent_posts.summary: A step-by-step guide to building custom property editors and custom property types for Salesforce Experience Builder using Lightning Web Components. Covers creating a custom property editor (e.g., a button group for text alignment), defining a complex property type using the new LightningTypeBundle metadata type with schema.json and editor.json files, and linking both to a Lightning Web Component via XML configuration. Custom property types support grouping sub-properties into tabs or accordions and enable reuse across multiple components.

recent_posts.title: What’s New in Salesforce Omnistudio Standard Designers
recent_posts.summary: Salesforce Omnistudio Standard Designers are now natively built into the Salesforce Platform, eliminating the need for separate managed package installations. Key improvements include near-instant activation (up to 9x faster than legacy packages), a redesigned canvas aligned with familiar Salesforce UI patterns, improved version management, a Design Assistant with soft guardrails to prevent overly complex components, and visual upgrades to the Integration Procedure and Data Mapper designers. New customers with an Industries license get immediate access, while existing package-runtime customers must migrate to gain access.

recent_posts.title: React vs. Salesforce: How I Rebuilt My “Vibe-Coded” App on the Platform
recent_posts.summary: A Salesforce Developer Advocate documents their experience rebuilding a React drag-and-drop tier list app using Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Salesforce platform tools. Key findings include: LWC uses native browser drag-and-drop APIs instead of npm packages like dnd-kit; Salesforce Custom Objects replace the need for a separate backend database and API; the platform's server-side compilation model requires deploying Apex classes before LWC components that reference them; and Salesforce Flows can replace webhooks/cron jobs for automation. The post highlights that the platform handles auth, database, hosting, and APIs out of the box, letting developers focus on business logic rather than infrastructure.

recent_posts.title: Agent Script徹底解説 – Agent Script言語の基本を学ぼう
recent_posts.summary: Agent Script is Salesforce's new language for building AI agents that combines deterministic code with natural language prompts through hybrid reasoning. The post covers core syntax including property-based key-value pairs, indentation rules, the @ symbol for resource references, pipe syntax for LLM prompts, template expressions for dynamic values, and slot-filling with .... It walks through the fundamental building blocks of an Agent Script file: config, variables, system, start_agent, topics, actions, and reasoning blocks. The reasoning block is central, allowing both deterministic action execution via run and LLM-driven tool calls via reasoning.actions. Topic transitions, after_reasoning hooks, and topic delegation are also explained with practical examples.

recent_posts.title: The Future of the Salesforce Developer in the Age of Agentic AI
recent_posts.summary: The Salesforce developer role is being reshaped by agentic AI, not eliminated. AI compresses implementation work (code generation, scaffolding) to near-zero, exposing system design, quality engineering, and cross-system thinking as the new high-value skills. Most Salesforce development happens in complex brownfield orgs where undocumented context and tribal knowledge are critical — areas AI cannot navigate alone. Developers must treat AI output as first drafts requiring rigorous validation, since fast generation increases the risk of accepting mediocre code. Career advice covers both early-career developers (AI accelerates learning platform internals) and experienced ones (redesign workflows, don't just add tools). The J-curve of AI adoption — slower before faster — is real and should be shared openly within the community.

recent_posts.title: Harness Lightning Experience Insights to Improve Performance
recent_posts.summary: Salesforce has made Lightning Experience Insights generally available in Spring '26 as part of Scale Center. The feature helps developers diagnose and optimize Lightning page performance within their own orgs. Key components include a Performance Overview using Experience Page Time (EPT) at the 75th percentile, Key Insights flagging deviations from best practices (e.g., too many components, missing Lightning CDN), Performance Trends broken down by geography and browser, and a High-Impact Slow Pages view that surfaces specific custom components causing delays. The platform has also improved overall Lightning Experience performance by 37% since the initiative began.

recent_posts.title: Agent Script Decoded: How to Debug Agent Script
recent_posts.summary: A guide to debugging Agentforce agents built with Agent Script. Covers the execution flow model (deterministic instruction phase vs. non-deterministic LLM reasoning), then walks through three debugging approaches: using the Interaction Summary and Trace panels in Agentforce Builder, using the Agent Tracer tab in the Agentforce DX VS Code extension, and a 'vibe debugging' workflow where you paste the JSON execution trace into Agentforce Vibes (or other AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor) to get AI-assisted diagnosis and code suggestions. Key mental models include understanding that start_agent always routes first each turn, that prompt text accumulates separately from logic, and that multi-turn bugs often live in variable state transitions.

recent_posts.title: Improved Accessibility Features in Salesforce Omnistudio
recent_posts.summary: Salesforce Omnistudio has undergone a major accessibility refactor, evaluating and improving over 45 elements across Omniscripts and Flexcards to meet WCAG 2.1 and 2.2 standards. Key enhancements include better form interactions (disabled attributes, autocomplete, less disruptive error handling), clearer visual indicators (checkmarks for selection, SVG alt text), and improved keyboard/screen reader support (correct ARIA roles, state change announcements, context-aware data table labels). The changes are opt-in via a toggle in the core designer to preserve backward compatibility for existing implementations, while new builds have accessibility enabled by default.

top_posts.title: Build Headless Agents with the Agent API
top_posts.summary: Headless agents are autonomous entities that focus on automation and integration with third-party systems without the need for a human interface. Salesforce's Agent API allows the creation of these agents to design complex, multi-agent workflows for various use cases, such as loan processing. The API supports both synchronous and asynchronous prompts, making it versatile for different implementations. Setting up and using the Agent API can unlock increased efficiency and automation for enterprise workflows.

top_posts.title: Building AI Applications with LangChain and Node.js
top_posts.summary: Learn how generative AI can be used to query content, the concept of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and the features and applications of LangChain, a comprehensive toolkit for integrating AI-powered language capabilities into applications.

top_posts.title: How to Build a Multimodal Agent in Salesforce
top_posts.summary: Salesforce introduces multimodal capabilities for Agentforce, enabling AI agents to process images and PDFs alongside text. The tutorial demonstrates building agents that can parse receipts for expense reports, troubleshoot from screenshots, and analyze documents. This extends traditional text-based LLM workflows to include visual and document understanding through Prompt Builder and Agentforce integration.

top_posts.title: Applying Fundamentals of Prompt Engineering with Prompt Builder
top_posts.summary: Prompt Builder helps developers create and manage reusable prompt templates integrated with Salesforce data. Techniques like few-shot prompting and chain-of-thought prompting enhance LLM responses by providing context and intermediate reasoning steps. Using tools like Prompt Builder in combination with Einstein Copilot simplifies the implementation and scaling of conversational AI, making AI applications more precise and contextually aware.

top_posts.title: Unlock Deeper Code Insights with User-Specified Context in Dev Assistant
top_posts.summary: Salesforce Dev Assistant now includes a User-Specified Context feature that allows developers to manually add specific files, methods, or code snippets to improve the AI's understanding of complex codebases. This enhancement addresses the limitation of only considering open files, enabling more accurate code analysis, better explanations of business logic, and properly placed code suggestions across multiple files and complex abstractions.
